title: SuperUser handoff card (frontmatter of .claude/superuser/handoff/<id>.md)
description: Contract for Quix and Agent Desk. Field names are stable; rename only with a new schema version.

id.description: <date>-<2-digit order>-<short english slug>; same as file and folder name

from.description: Who gave the task (team lead, a user, another bot)

to.description: Agent that does the task, e.g. general-purpose, or a domain agent such as software-company:developer

tier.description: Model tier + effort, e.g. 'กลาง · medium' (ใหญ่ = large, กลาง = medium, เล็ก = small)

status.description: done · in progress · blocked · awaiting approval · pending

depends_on.description: ids that must be done first

files_allowed.description: Glob paths this worker may change; empty = read-only
